name: get_payslip
description: Get the signed-in employee's payslip for one month: gross, each deduction (PF, professional tax, TDS, loss of pay) and net pay.

month.description: Payslip month as YYYY-MM, e.g. 2026-09 for September 2026

name: get_leave_balance
description: Get the signed-in employee's current leave balance by type (earned, sick, casual, comp off) and any leave pending approval.

name: get_vendor_invoice_status
description: Get the status of one of the signed-in supplier's invoices: PO number, amount, status, expected payment date or paid date, and any action needed.

invoiceNo.description: Supplier invoice number exactly as printed, e.g. SLFS/2026-27/0167

name: get_visitor_pass
description: Get the signed-in visitor's campus visitor pass: date, time slot, host, gate, building and status.
